findings.highlight: There's no telling when she might go out of control again.
findings.evidenceJa: 次に暴走したら後がない
findings.governingReading: 次に暴走したら後がない warns another episode leaves no further chance.
findings.explanation: No margin after next runaway episode becomes unknowable next timing.

findings.highlight: the pain and fear might well have never existed.
findings.evidenceJa: 痛かったとか怖かったとか、そういう記憶がないぐらい
findings.governingReading: 記憶がない expressly locates the easy ending in absence of recalled pain/fear, crucial to training gaps.
findings.explanation: No memories of fear or pain becomes fear and pain might never have existed.

findings.highlight: She told me something that anyone would know.
findings.evidenceJa: 誰でも知っている事のように
findings.governingReading: 誰でも知っている事のように qualifies the manner Illya told him about short lifespan.
findings.explanation: As if anyone knew becomes fact anyone would know.

findings.highlight: Her life is becoming more confined with each passing day
findings.evidenceJa: 日に日に自由がきかなくなっている桜。
findings.governingReading: 自由がきかなくなる resumes inability to control body, explained by bodily worms and low energy.
findings.explanation: Failing bodily control becomes a more confined life.

findings.highlight: If I give her some blood and supply her with enough power
findings.evidenceJa: 何度でも血を分けて、十分すぎるぐらい魔力を補充すれば
findings.governingReading: 何度でも commits to however many repetitions needed; 十分すぎる adds excess rather than minimum.
findings.explanation: Repeated blood-sharing and more than enough supply shrink to some blood and enough.

findings.governingReading: みんなは救えない in context of only one choice means cannot save everyone; one remains savable in Illya’s pressure.
findings.explanation: Cannot save all becomes all beyond saving.

findings.highlight: She couldn't possibly be the Sakura that came onto me that one night.
findings.evidenceJa: あの時のように、頬を染めて桜が寄り添ってきたワケじゃない。
findings.governingReading: 頬を染めて寄り添ってきたワケじゃない negates current blushing approach like previous replenishment occasion.
findings.explanation: She has not approached like earlier becomes she cannot be that earlier Sakura.

findings.highlight: I know I shouldn't ask what they were.
findings.evidenceJa: 聞かなくてはいけないのに。
findings.governingReading: 聞かなくてはいけないのに says he ought to ask but cannot speak; embrace substitutes avoidance.
findings.explanation: Must ask dream content becomes should not ask.

findings.highlight: I've always wanted to do this with her.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ、桜とこうしていたかった。
findings.governingReading: ただ、桜とこうしていたかった expresses narrowed current desire to be together like this.
findings.explanation: Only wanted this now becomes always wanted it.

findings.highlight: There's been so many times I wanted to hug Sakura until I pass out.
findings.evidenceJa: 意識が途切れるまで、何度も桜を抱きしめたかった。
findings.governingReading: 何度も modifies embracing until awareness ceases, enacted by 実際そうした next.
findings.explanation: Wanted repeated embraces now becomes repeated past occasions of wanting.

findings.highlight: I'm the one who's being satisfied.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜以上に満ち足りずにいる。
findings.governingReading: 桜以上に満ち足りず contrasts her apparent need with his greater unfulfilled hunger.
findings.explanation: He is more unsatisfied than Sakura becomes he is the satisfied one.
